collection_disposition.postprocessing_disclosure: Post-freeze descriptive addition prompted by the first-six completed-slot no-action diagnostic. No generation setting, prompt, sample, frozen primary metric or stopping rule was changed. Execution-conditional measurements supplement complete planned-denominator reporting; they are not a new confirmatory hypothesis or an independent task-population estimate.
collection_disposition.runner_gate: No runner.lock and a terminal, valid hash-chained run_stopped event; all closed-study file hashes rechecked before final receipt.

interpretation.counts: Execution/effect measures cover completed immutable traces only. Failed/partial execution is not treated as zero activity; its measurements are unavailable. Model-call counts cover all statuses using the provider request journal.
interpretation.effects: Ledger counts describe commits, including reversed effects. Excess payload matches are raw lifetime multiplicity, not a stability-contract verdict.
interpretation.faults: Intended condition labels are distinct from evaluator-reported injected fault paths and observable response/effect/source-lag manifestations. A no-action episode does not exercise its scheduled tool fault. Clean attempts are not faults.
interpretation.injection: fault_applied identifies entry into the simulator fault branch; it does not by itself prove the named effect manifested. Consult manifestation signals.
interpretation.lag: Horizon gap sums are descriptive milliseconds across observations, not latency estimates. A stale watermark can be realized even without a dispatched refund.
interpretation.provenance: Origin omission counts require an actual publicly visible effect record whose hidden origin fields were suppressed. Configured omission without such a record is not measured as realized provenance loss.
interpretation.retries: Retry intention, repeat provider attempt and repeat actual dispatch are separate counts. A dispatch event excludes fail-before-dispatch attempts.
